segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ עָבְרָה גָּדֵר שֶׁהוּא גָּבוֹהַּ אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת, אוֹ דֶרֶךְ הָרַבִּים, אוֹ נָהָר – פָּטוּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one kindled a fire that «crossed a fence that is four cubits high, or» if the fire crossed «the public thoroughfare, or» if the fire crossed «a river,» and in each case it caused damage on the other side, he is «exempt» from liability.

moves.cueHe: עברה גדר שהוא גבוה ארבע אמות
moves.summary: exemption when fire crosses a barrier

positions.claim: exempt if the fire crossed a four-cubit fence, a public thoroughfare or a river
